events.title: Sushi On Wheels Demo!
events.summary: Hello, everyone!So happy to announce that the Demo for Sushi On Wheels is available now!! I hope you all enjoy making sushi for the locals of the Izu Peninsula! If you have any questions, come over and say hi in the discussions 👋 I'd love to hear from you! And if you have any feedback on the Demo, Please fill out this form! Thank you for coming along for the adventure! 🍣

events.title: Redrawing the World of Sushi On Wheels
events.summary: Hello, everyone!Hey Everyone! We've been working really hard on getting a demo ready for the game!Recently I've been working on lots of back end systems for the game so haven't had a lot to show! However, I also gave the map of the Izu Peninsula a total overhaul! The world map is one of the first things you see before setting out in your sushi truck, so I wanted it to feel like more than a simple location select screen. events.title: 🍣 Sushi On Wheels beta is in 1 week!!
events.summary: Hello, everyone!It's just 1 week until the beta playtest! The playtest will take place from the 3rd of April 2026 until the 5th of April!For anyone unaware of how a beta playtest works, on the 3rd of April you'll be sent a key to access the beta through Steam, then on the 5th of April, access to the beta will be removed as the playtest ends.
